title: Outputs estruturados/consistentes (templates + ports do reporter) + AskUserQuestion canonico
description: OBJETIVO: respostas sempre no mesmo padrao por fase + uso definido de AskUserQuestion. A parte de VERIFICACAO (two-layer, rubrica do reviewer, criterios checaveis por maquina) foi SEPARADA na CAM-56 (modelo Jaymin West, densa); esta issue cobre o resto, baseado nos ports do projeto reporter (skills ralph-*). STORIES: (1) Output templates fixos: formato sempre igual para a proposta do plan (MVP/Launch-ready ja existe), o summary do ship, e o SHAPE do verdict do review (a rubrica/conteudo do verdict vem da CAM-56; aqui e so o template/shape). (2) Docs-fetch estruturado no plan (port reporter ralph-plan Step 4.6): tabela lib->canal, 1 fetch alvo por lib, captura {lib,url,version,fetchedAt,summary,status}, guard anti-over-fetch, deteccao de conflito vs convencoes locais (adaptar libs do cam: ink, bun, js-yaml, chalk). (3) Triage guardrails no review (port reporter ralph-review Step 4): valide a sugestao vs a realidade do projeto; demote CRITICAL que precisa de decisao de produto para nova issue; 3+ issues num review = smell. (4) Setup-checklist no ship (port reporter ralph-ship): tabela padronizada de acoes manuais do usuario (config/install/env). (5) AskUserQuestion canonico: momentos fixos onde SEMPRE usa, aprovacao de escopo no plan (Step 6), ambiguidade/blocker, e triage de review que precisa de decisao de produto. ARQUIVOS: .claude/commands/cam-plan.md, cam-review.md, cam-ship.md; .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md; espelhar templates/ + embed-vendor. FONTE: ~/Documents/Projects/reporter (.claude/commands/ralph-*.md). Memoria: agent-eval-research-jaymin-reporter. RELACIONA: CAM-56 (verificacao/rubrica que o template do verdict consome; fazer CAM-56 antes), CAM-55 (hub). ACEITE: cada fase emite o template fixo; docs-fetch estruturado no plan; triage guardrails no review; setup-checklist no ship; AskUserQuestion usado nos momentos definidos; embed-vendor:check; typecheck; tests.

spec.scope: Port the remaining reporter output-consistency features to cam's DETERMINISTIC artifact layer (report JSON + composePrBody sections + planner schema), NOT markdown command prose, narrowed to the genuinely-unshipped deltas. Reconcile with shipped architecture: (a) operator-decision moments use the EXISTING file-based gate (cam decide / cam-gate.schema.json, ADR-0041) -- do NOT introduce AskUserQuestion (disallowed for every cam subagent); (b) review triage guardrails + structured reviewer exit report already shipped (CAM-75) so the triage story is hardening/parity only; (c) verification/rubric is CAM-56 (shipped) and OUT of scope. Deltas: S1 deterministic plan scope-proposal artifact (MVP-vs-launch-ready framing); S2 planner docs-fetch lib->channel table + anti-over-fetch guard + local-convention-conflict detection, extending the existing officialDocsConsulted/officialDocsValidated shapes; S4 setup-checklist section added to composePrBody; S3 review triage brought to reporter parity (hardening only); S5 the 3 operator-decision moments wired to the file-based gate.
acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic plan scope-proposal artifact with a fixed shape (problem, in-scope stories, explicit out-of-scope, MVP-vs-launch-ready framing) is produced at plan completion and narrated by the orchestrator; its shape is a hand-rolled TS guard consistent with ADR-0038, not zod/json-schema.

The planner docs-fetch gains a lib->fetch-channel table, an anti-over-fetch guard (one targeted fetch per lib), and local-convention-conflict detection, extending the existing officialDocsConsulted (planner) / officialDocsValidated (handoff.schema.json) shapes rather than adding a parallel mechanism.

composePrBody (src/release/pr-body.ts) gains a setup-checklist section rendered as a | # | Item | Where | How | Status | table populated by detection heuristics, added alongside the existing fixed sections.

The cam-review triage guardrails reach reporter parity (routing table, validate-suggestion-vs-project-reality, demote CRITICAL-needing-product-decision to an issue, 3+ issues = smell) as hardening of the already-shipped CAM-75 triage, with no new mechanism.

The operator-decision moments (scope approval, ambiguity/blocker, review product-decision triage) are wired to the EXISTING file-based gate primitive (cam decide / cam-gate.schema.json, ADR-0041); AskUserQuestion is NOT introduced and stays disallowed for all subagents.

All new output shapes target the deterministic artifact layer (report JSON + composePrBody + planner schema), not markdown command prose; any touched template file is mirrored to templates/ and re-embedded via bun run embed-vendor.
typecheck passes, check:all is green, pre-existing plan/ship/review/report tests pass, and new tests cover each new artifact shape.
gotchas: AskUserQuestion is disallowed for EVERY cam subagent (planner/reviewer/implementer/auditor/orchestrator agent docs) and cam deliberately chose file-based operator gates (ADR-0041); do NOT re-enable it -- Story 5 is reframed to the file-based gate.
plan/ship facing summaries are composed DETERMINISTICALLY (composePrBody src/release/pr-body.ts:86-109; plan-verdict-report.ts), not by markdown command prose; target those artifacts.
cam report shapes are hand-rolled TS guards, not zod/json-schema (ADR-0038, patterns.md:104); follow that convention for any new artifact.

Review triage + '3+ = smell' + the structured reviewer exit report already shipped (CAM-75, .claude/commands/cam-review.md:116-145); the triage story is parity/hardening, not greenfield -- do not duplicate.
docs-fetch: officialDocsConsulted (subagent-planner.md:36-61) and officialDocsValidated (handoff.schema.json:45-77) already exist; extend them, do not create a parallel channel.
CAM-56 (verification/two-layer/reviewer rubric) is shipped and OUT of scope; do not touch the reviewer rubric.

This is 5 loosely-related deltas and a strong split candidate (PRD-size lesson: loosely-related multi-story PRDs blow review); the planner/auditor may slice, and if the PRD exceeds ~8 stories expect a follow-up slice.

Reporter source blueprints live at ~/Documents/Projects/reporter/.claude/commands/: ralph-plan.md (Step 4.6 docs-fetch :121-149, Step 4.7 scope :151-208), ralph-review.md (Step 4 :137-174), ralph-ship.md (Step 14 :73-105).
domainTerms: scope-proposal artifact: a fixed-shape deterministic summary emitted at plan completion (problem, in-scope stories, explicit out-of-scope, MVP-vs-launch-ready framing) that the orchestrator narrates.
docs-fetch channel table: the lib->official-docs-channel mapping the planner consults, with one targeted fetch per lib.
anti-over-fetch guard: the rule capping docs fetches to one per lib to prevent redundant retrieval.
setup-checklist: the ship-time | # | Item | Where | How | Status | table of manual setup steps a change requires.
file-based operator gate: cam's shipped operator-decision primitive (cam-gate.schema.json + cam decide, ADR-0041), used instead of AskUserQuestion.
reporter port: a feature ported from the sibling reporter project's .claude/commands/ralph-*.md blueprints.
